EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), mosquitto: src/conf.c. These 130 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 130 FP, 0 TP.

FP shapes: cur_listener, cur_bridge and cur_plugin in config__read_file_core, each dominated by a REQUIRE_* macro (src/conf.c:65-113) that returns when the pointer is NULL, with no reassignment between; REQUIRE_LISTENER_OR_DEFAULT_LISTENER, where config__create_default_listener leaves a non-null default listener on success. cur_security_options rows are medium: they rest on every writer of a listener's security_options checking its allocation.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
